steps: Thaw and brown ground pork in a large skillet on COOK-01. Season with salt. Set aside.
Scramble 18 eggs in the same skillet over medium heat. Remove from heat when just set.
Lay out all 24 tortillas. Divide pork and eggs evenly across them.
Top each with a generous pinch of shredded mozzarella.
Roll tight and wrap individually in foil or plastic wrap.
Freeze immediately on a flat sheet. Transfer to a bag once solid.
